reason: A Feishu/Lark bot integration that relays conversations with DeepSeek Harness and supports workspace management and group-chat collaboration.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书或 Lark，支持在聊天中交流、切换工作区并进行团队协作。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Feishu or Lark for chat-based conversations, workspace switching, and team collaboration.

capabilities: Connects Feishu/Lark messaging with DeepSeek Harness
Relays user messages and responses between external services
Supports workspace and conversation switching in chats
Enables group-chat collaboration with the bot
